This is a list of [[Hispanic and Latino Americans in the United States Congress|Hispanic and Latino Americans]] who have served in the [[United States Congress]]. Persons included are identified as having a lineage from [[Spain]] or [[Latin America]], a definition that includes [[Brazil]], but not [[Portugal]].

Entries shaded in gray refer to current members of the U.S. Congress.

|'''{{sortname|Maxwell Alejandro|Frost}}'''<br>{{small|(born 1997)}}
|Cuban{{#tag:ref|Frost was adopted at birth, and raised from birth, by a Cuban-American family. Reliable sources invariably describe Frost, and he describes himself, as Cuban. See, ''e.g.'', {{cite news |last1=Lai |first1=Stephanie |title=Maxwell Frost, First Gen Z Congressman, Gets His Bearings on Capitol Hill |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2022/12/06/us/politics/maxwell-frost-gen-z-congress-florida.html |access-date=January 22, 2024 |work=The New York Times |date=December 6, 2022}} ("Representative-elect Maxwell Frost, a 25-year-old Afro-Cuban progressive activist from Orlando ...."); {{cite web |title=Maxwell Frost: el primer congresista de Estados Unidos de la generación Z y negro de origen cubano |url=https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2022/11/09/maxwell-frost-el-primer-congresista-de-estados-unidos-de-la-generacion-z-y-negro-de-origen-cubano/ |website=CNN en Español |access-date=January 22, 2024 |date=November 9, 2022}} ("También es el primer negro de origen cubano elegido para el Congreso."); {{cite magazine |url= https://www.vogue.com/article/maxwell-alejandro-frost-gen-z-congressman-elect-interview |title= Maxwell Alejandro Frost, Gen Z’s First Congressman, Is Living His Abuela’s ‘Wildest Dream’ |last=Ruiz |first=Michelle |date=November 11, 2022 |magazine=Vogue |access-date=January 22, 2024}} ("On Tuesday night, 25-year-old Maxwell Alejandro Frost made history as the first member of Gen Z—and the first Afro-Cuban—elected to the U.S. House of Representatives."); and {{Cite web |title=Meet Maxwell |url=https://www.frostforcongress.com/meet-maxwell |access-date=January 22, 2024 |website=Frost for Congress}} ("My family’s story begins in Cuba, with my grandmother Yeya. She and my mother came to Florida from Cuba during the Freedom Flights in the early 1960s with only a suitcase and no money."). Frost's biological parents invariably have been described by reliable sources as a Haitian man and a woman of Lebanese ancestry whose origin sometimes is given as Puerto Rican and other times as Argentine. See, ''e.g.'', {{cite web |last1=Bernal |first1=Rafael |title=Who is Maxwell Alejandro Frost, the 25-year-old Democratic House nominee? |url=https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/3614214-who-is-maxwell-alejandro-frost-the-25-year-old-democratic-house-nominee/ |website=The Hill |access-date=18 January 2024}} ("His birth parents were a Lebanese Puerto Rican woman and a Haitian man."); and {{cite web |last1=Dorsey |first1=Xander |title=Empowering Generation Z to Take Action |url=https://kpcnotebook.scholastic.com/post/empowering-generation-z-take-action/ |website=Scholastic Kids Press |access-date=January 22, 2024 |date= July 18, 2023}} ("Frost was born to a mother of Lebanese and Argentine descent and a Haitian father.")|group="note"}}
